# aout-challenge — Full Reverse Engineering Report

## Executive Summary

`aout-challenge` is a **64-bit ELF PIE (Position-Independent Executable)** targeting x86-64 architecture. It is dynamically linked against libc, compiled with **stack canary protection** (`__stack_chk_fail`), and includes **debug symbols** (not stripped). The binary implements a small interactive challenge using basic I/O functions (`getchar`, `putchar`, `write`) and introduces delays via `usleep`. Upon execution it exits cleanly with return code 0.
